{{Top|leg}}
A '''Trogan meter''' was a unit of measurement of length used on the planet [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]]. It was 25 percent longer than the [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meter]].

[[Teela Kaarz]] once had to quickly redesign a dining hall onboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] to Imperial specifications after someone mistranslated a measurement system using Trogan meters.
